post.description: Multipart field `file`: a JPEG, PNG or WebP image (recognised by its content, not its name), at most 10 MB (413 file.too_large, also for a chunked body) and 25 megapixels (422 file.too_many_pixels). Other or damaged content is 415 file.type. JPEG and PNG are re-encoded in the same format without metadata, turned upright and scaled down to 1600 px wide; WebP is validated and stored as uploaded. The same stored bytes always give the same file.
